company_name: JIANGSU SHENZHOU SEMI TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized power supply systems crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Jiangsu Shenzhou Semi Technology Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor industry, offering advanced power supply solutions tailored for semiconductor production lines. Their expertise includes the development and manufacturing of remote plasma source systems, RF power supply systems, and high-voltage pulse power systems, alongside comprehensive technical support services.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province, with significant operations supporting the global semiconductor market.
